audit.whatIsWrong: Content and full concede levels 3-5 and first item to Yorick; the packet chart gives Graves the first six rows and Yorick only 2+ items. Every why on the page says Graves wins those rows — whys[2] 'you out-stat his ghoul-backed trades', whys[3] 'make his short trades unprofitable', whys[5] 'Your Eclipse/Youmuu's spike lands first', mid opens 'This is your takeover'.
audit.why: 56.1% and the clearest scaling story in the slice: Graves owns everything before two items, Yorick owns everything after. The chart was blurring exactly the line the player needs to see.
audit.corrected: win[1], win[2], win[3], win[5] and the matching phases sides set to Graves; ratings 7/7/7/7/7/7/3.

audit.why: Spikes at 2-3, 6, first item and late are right and the mechanism holds — Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1, so his Maiden pressure really is an item-timing problem rather than a level-6 one.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist's cooldown added to early where the advice says 'dodge it'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six errors. (a) 'Bushwhack armor' appears five times as the name of Graves' E buff. Bushwhack is not a Graves ability at all — his E is Quickdraw and the armor/MR buff is True Grit. This is a fabricated ability name of exactly the Brand/'Ares of Blaze' kind. (b) 'the auto-reset' on Graves' E — the kit says hitting enemies with basic attacks LOWERS the cooldown and refreshes the resist boost; there is no auto-attack reset and no autoReset flag on the ability. (c) 'Maiden's heal' three times — Eulogy of the Isles grants bonus damage against the Maiden's target and raises Walkers; the heal in Yorick's kit is Last Rites (Q). (d) 'second E charge' four times — Quickdraw has no charges. (e) 'Smoke Screen blinds' — W reduces sight range and slows. (f) 'R as the disengage knockback' — Collateral Damage has no displacement.
audit.why: 'Bushwhack' is the highest-severity kind of error on this site: a player searching for it finds nothing and stops trusting the page. 'Maiden's heal' sends anti-heal timing to the wrong ability — the sustain to cut is Last Rites, which is up every 4 seconds at rank 5.
audit.corrected: True Grit and Quickdraw named correctly, cooldown refund instead of auto-reset, Last Rites named as the heal, charges removed, W and R described from their own text.

audit.why: Win conditions are stated cleanly on both sides and the 'do not 1v1 his splitpush' line is the right call for a reloading marksman against a ghoul swarm.

edits.before: Yorick is slow and you out-DPS him point-blank from level 1 — take every CS trade in melee range where all four pellets land, and Q off the wall behind him for the detonation bounce. The instant you hit 2-3, start the weave: auto, E in for the True Grit armor and the cooldown refund, auto again, then dash back out before his ghouls catch up. edits.before: This is your takeover. Keep your second E charge for his Dark Procession wall: when he cages you, dash over or through it rather than burning R on the escape. Hold Collateral Damage for the all-in — the execute cuts through Maiden's heal and the cone clears the ghouls behind him. Take plates with your tempo and hunt picks with Smoke Screen blinds and R snipes rather than sieging into a full ghoul swarm.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Your True Grit stacks refresh every time Quickdraw's cooldown refunds off an auto, faster than his short ghoul-backed trades can punish, so fight in shell rhythm — two shells and out, reload behind the wave. Keep Quickdraw for his Dark Procession wall: when he cages you, dash over or through it rather than burning R on the escape. Hold Collateral Damage for the all-in — the nuke cuts through his Last Rites heal and the cone clears the ghouls behind him. Take plates with your tempo and hunt picks behind Smoke Screen's sight denial rather than sieging into a full swarm.

edits.after: E-weave the True Grit armor so his short ghoul-backed trades are unprofitable, and save Quickdraw to dash clear of Dark Procession's bone wall

notes: 'Bushwhack armor' is a fabricated Graves ability name appearing five times — Graves' E is Quickdraw and the resist buff is True Grit. Same class of error as the Brand 'Ares of Blaze' calibration case. 'Maiden's heal' was also wrong: the heal in Yorick's kit is Last Rites (Q), which matters because it sets anti-heal timing. I left the Divine Sunderer references alone in late/spikes[3] — I cannot verify from the brief whether that item exists on 26.15, and it is recorded in unverified rather than guessed at.
